steps.result: Meteor Connect Request for veil-eta-khaki.vercel.app approved

Meteor Sign Message showed the site veil-eta-khaki.vercel.app, account veil-wallet-recv and the message "Veil key derivation v2: derive private receiving keys for this NEAR account. Account: veil-wallet-recv.testnet"; approved twice in the recording, and both times the app matched the registered keys
steps.keyCheck: The keys registered for veil-wallet-recv.testnet equal the keys @veil/sdk derives from a standard NEP-413 signature of the v2 request (recipient veil-eta-khaki.vercel.app) by the same account key, and not those of the v1 request

steps.result: Registration transaction succeeded. Its wallet approval screen is not in the recording: the name was already registered when the recorded take began, so the app showed "Name registered" after matching keys.
Approved in Meteor (Approve Transaction to router2.veil-williams.testnet); receipt "0.0200 NEAR Delivered privately"

Inbox "Found 1 private payment"; after the browser re-link warning the app signed a 0.005 NEAR transfer from the receiving account to veil-wallet-send.testnet with the derived key (no wallet pop-up, by design)
